brand.oneLiner: Resend is an email platform for developers to build, send, and scale transactional and marketing emails.
topicsAllowed: React Email component library and templating
Modular webhooks and email event tracking
brand.targetAudience: Software engineers, developers, and engineering teams building email capabilities into web and backend applications.
brand.visualStyle: Clean, modern developer aesthetic with dark-mode code editors, syntax-highlighted snippets, and minimalist product UI.
uniqueSellingPoints: Build email templates using React and Tailwind via the open-source react-email library instead of legacy HTML table layouts
First-class multi-language SDK support across Node.js, Python, Ruby, Go, Rust, Java, Elixir, .NET, PHP, CLI, REST, and SMTP
Built-in Test Mode to safely simulate events and experiment with APIs without sending emails to real users
Proactive DNSBL blocklist monitoring (such as Spamhaus) with automated removal requests
proofPoints: Resend includes a Test mode to simulate events and experiment with the API without sending real emails.
Resend delivers modular webhooks when an email is delivered, opened, bounces, or a link is clicked.
Resend templates can be built using React with react-email, an open-source component library.
Resend generates removal requests if your domain is added to DNSBLs like Spamhaus.
Resend supports sending emails from North American, South American, European, and Asian regions.
Resend offers managed dedicated IPs that automatically warm up and autoscale based on sending volume.
Raycast switched from SendGrid to Resend and completed waitlist email setup for iOS and Windows apps within 30 minutes.
Companies using Resend include Vercel, Infisical, Mintlify, MrBeast, Gumroad, Replit, Tailwind, and Braintrust.
Resend Inbound parses email attachments and delivers them with metadata, content type, and base64-encoded data.
Resend Inbound lets you receive emails using a Resend-provided email address or on your own domain.
Resend Webhooks feature automatic retries with exponential backoff for failed deliveries.
Resend allows users to inspect webhook request payloads, response bodies, and attempt counts, as well as manually replay messages.
Resend Audiences supports SDKs in PHP, Python, Ruby, Go, Java, and cURL to add and manage contacts.
Contacts can be added to Resend Audiences via CSV upload, manual entry, or API.
Hike Medical uses Resend Audiences to manage contacts and track reporting.
contentAngles: Building and styling emails with React and Tailwind using react-email
Implementing and debugging email webhooks for delivery, opens, clicks, and bounces
Using Test Mode to safely test transactional email workflows during development
Monitoring sender reputation and DNSBL blocklist prevention
Sending emails across diverse backend environments and SDKs
Managing subscriber lists and tracking broadcast performance analytics

Resend Templates includes presence indicators, auto-save, and a full revision history system for team collaboration.
Liveblocks uses React Email and Tailwind to create branded components and templates with Resend.
Resend Broadcasts allows users to send email blasts to contacts using a WYSIWYG editor.
Resend Broadcasts supports Markdown for headings, lists, italic, bold, links, and quotes.
Resend Broadcasts tracks individual engagement by showing who opened emails and what links each person clicked.
Resend optimizes deliverability by breaking down thousands of emails into smaller batches and spacing them out.
The Resend Free plan includes 3,000 emails per month, 100 emails a day, 3 domains, 10,000 automation runs, and 30-day data retention.
The Resend Pro plan includes 50,000 emails per month, 10 domains, no daily email limit, 5 webhook endpoints, 100 AI credits per month, and extra emails at $0.90 per 1,000.
The Resend Scale plan includes 100,000 emails per month, 1,000 domains, a dedicated Slack channel, 10 webhook endpoints, and 500 AI credits per month.
Resend add-on pricing includes Domains for $20 per month, Dedicated IPs for $30 per month, and Single Sign-On for $150 per month.
Infisical switched to Resend Dedicated IPs to improve deliverability.
Raycast switched to Resend from SendGrid, starting with waitlist emails for their iOS and Windows apps.
Resend was founded by Zeno Rocha, Bu Kinoshita, and Jonni Lundy.
Resend started with an open source project in 2022 and launched its email sending platform in 2023 as part of Y Combinator's winter batch.
Resend is built by a fully remote team for developers.
Roame has been using Resend since July 2023.
Roame migrated their drag-and-drop templates to React Email and swapped API keys in their Next.js API endpoints to start sending with Resend.
Resend provided Roame with one-on-one, real-time help over Slack.
Roame CTO Zi Liu stated that Resend is SendGrid with batteries at 1/10 of the price.
Roame Travel was founded in San Francisco in 2019.
Sorce provisions a custom sorce.email address for every user using the Resend API.
A Resend email expert helped Sorce ship a fix for bounce issues in under 24 hours.
Sorce was founded in August 2024 and has been using Resend since November 2025.
Theya used the Resend Broadcasts feature to send announcements during their launch week.
Theya was founded in San Francisco in 2023 and has been using Resend since November 2023.
Resend provides Broadcasts and Audiences features for sending emails to users.

Resend integrates with notification systems including Courier, Novu, Knock, Engagespot, Dittofeed, and Suprsend.

The Usage API allows retrieving current usage and plan limits across account quotas by calling GET /usage with any API key.
The Usage API response covers quotas for emails, contacts, segments, broadcasts, domains, AI credits, automation runs, and API rate limits.
In the Usage API, a limit value of null indicates there is no cap for that resource on your plan.
The Resend MCP server includes a get-usage tool for agents to check account limits.
Resend integrated with Stripe Projects to enable provisioning Resend directly from the Stripe CLI.
Stripe Projects creates a Resend account, generates an API key, and writes it to your .env file as RESEND_API_KEY.
The Stripe Projects integration allows signing into the Resend dashboard and managing billing through Stripe.
Stripe Projects includes Agent Skills that enable AI agents to provision Resend through the CLI.
Validity's Heatwave blocklist has listed more than 1.2 million domains warmed through synthetic engagement.
Validity shares Heatwave blocklist signals with providers and security vendors including Comcast, Proofpoint, Spamhaus, and SURBL.
Domains can be checked for Heatwave synthetic warming listings at lookup.validity.tools.
A domain's position on Validity's Heatwave blocklist for synthetic warming is permanent once it crosses the threshold.
Allie Sperry joined Resend as a Customer Success Engineer.
Allie Sperry previously worked in support at Litmus and as a deliverability consultant at Customer.io.
Gaby Garcia spent 5 years at Automattic hiring engineers and designers.
The Email Metrics API returns deliverability and engagement data from send volume to unsubscribe rate, grouped or filtered by period, domain, broadcast, or email.
A request to the Email Metrics API with no parameters returns every metric over the past 7 days.
The Cancel Broadcast API lets developers stop a Broadcast programmatically while it is scheduled or during sending.
The Share Email API returns a read-only share link for any sent or received email with a customizable expiration duration of up to 48 hours.
The Duplicate Automation API creates a copy of an existing Automation as a disabled draft with a (Copy) suffix.
The Update Segment API allows renaming a segment programmatically via API, CLI, or official SDKs.
The List Clicked Links API returns every link clicked in a Broadcast with its total and unique clicks ranked by total clicks.
The Email Verification API proposal allows verifying email addresses directly within the browser instead of sending an OTP or magic link.
The proposed browser Email Verification API is supported by Chrome via an origin trial and mailbox verification is supported by Gmail.
